g.text: Figure 3b | Event-aligned regional population activation in success and failure trials

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: Columns are cue, reach, grasp and at-mouth; within each area, success and failure rows are adjacent. Every heatmap uses one shared z scale, and the trace below is trial mean ± SEM.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: Each row is one event-aligned trial from −1 to +2 s; trials lacking that event are excluded (at-mouth: success n=49, failure n=14). Regional signals are standardized across all trial-time samples. This is descriptive activation timing—not cross-area interaction, directionality or causal influence.
